name: gizza-ai/bpm-key-tag-reader
summary: Read the stored tempo and musical-key tags from a track and convert the key to Camelot or Open Key

tool.description: Read the tempo (BPM) and musical key that are already STORED in a track's tags, and convert the key into traditional, Camelot (harmonic-mixing wheel) and Open Key notation. Reads ID3v2 TBPM/TKEY and the TXXX: frames DJ software writes (INITIALKEY, EnergyLevel), Vorbis comments (BPM, INITIALKEY, KEY), the MP4/iTunes tmpo atom and com.apple.iTunes freeform atoms, plus RIFF INFO and ID3v1 — across MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A/MP4, WAV, AIFF, CAF and MKV/WebM. Reports which literal field each value came from, and understands keys stored as names (Am, F#m, C major), Camelot codes (8A) or Open Key codes (1m). This reads existing tags only — it does NOT analyse the audio, so an untagged file reports that no tempo/key tags are stored. WMA/ASF and APEv2 tags are not supported. Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

include_all_tags.description: Also list every other tag stored in the file, not just the tempo, key and energy ones. Useful for finding a non-standard field a DJ app used. Default: false.

key_notation.description: Which notation to report the musical key in: standard (traditional names like 'A minor'), camelot (harmonic-mixing wheel codes like '8A'), open-key (codes like '1m'), or all three at once. Default: all.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Audio URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
